race.comment: ASTROGAZER (4) has found form at the right time, backing a solid Muswellbrook third with a close Goulburn second on soft ground when sent out favourite. He handles rain-affected going, has a win at this distance and brings the most reliable recent profile. SNAP DECISION (2) is the proven this-track mile winner, and his Albury sixth came in BM66 grade, so the class drop and quick back-up give him a clear rebound case. ZIPPY LION (8) had excuses in a CL1 at Canberra after jumping awkwardly and being held up, while his Moruya Mdn win two back showed he is still progressing. GUNFIGHTER ROAD (5) resumed with a sound BM55 fourth at Canberra and has a strong overall record for a lightly raced horse, though this is a sharper assignment. SPLENDID MAGNUS (10) won't be far away.
